correctness.rationale: The exact GF(2^12) quotient is justified by Rabin polynomial irreducibility checks, and the chosen element has full multiplicative order 4095. The two BCH defining zero conditions reduce every anchored five-point word to a complementary syndrome-pair match. Independent compiled and Python enumerators check 36,856 pairs, 210 disjoint ordered matches, 35 unique supports through position zero and seven free cyclic orbits totaling 1,911 words. The direct root checks and seven representative supports are reproduced and exhaustive by construction.

value.rationale: Minimum-weight supports are the natural first nonzero layer of a linear code and inform its combinatorial error-event geometry. The complete exact orbit structure separates one inherited subgroup orbit from six genuinely noninherited Frobenius-conjugate orbits at the first length-273 case, information not determined by the previously known [273,249,5] parameters. The claim is an intrinsic, complete finite classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
